evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public no-login ArcGIS layer 'Listed buildings' (layer 669) is a polygon feature layer under Historic Environment with display field Name. Its description states that the dataset is maintained and amended by the Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record based on Historic England data, covers Devon, Torbay and Dartmoor HER administrative areas, and explicitly warns that any records in central Exeter are out of date. Therefore this live service confirms an official polygon/name source surface but also supplies an explicit currentness blocker for central Exeter.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer metadata declares esriGeometryPolygon, but central Exeter records are explicitly described as out of date.
field_evidence.type_use: Layer display field is Name, but no current central-Exeter record window is accepted because of the source's explicit staleness warning.
field_evidence.currentness: Official layer description states: any records in central Exeter are out of date.
